plan.title: Closed RFQ Report Download with Revised Bids

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ without recreating or searching for the event.
Open the RFQ Responses view where the report control is available.
Open the Download Reports window from the RFQ Responses screen.
Verify that the Download Reports window opened.
Verify the Excel download action is available.
Download the report with Include Revised Bids enabled.
Verify that the Excel report download completed.
Reopen the Download Reports window for the disabled-checkbox variant.
Verify that the report window reopened.
Download the report with Include Revised Bids disabled.
Verify that the second Excel report download completed.
